manifest.note: Only latency (cost_ms) is hardware dependent; every other number is a pure function of the seed, the family set and the label sheets.

families.task_shape: evaluate K arithmetic expressions with precedence
families.premise: exact rational arithmetic, no external tools
families.scoring: fraction of expressions whose value matches exactly (rel tol 1e-9)

families.task_shape: convert K quantities between units of the same dimension
families.premise: closed set of exact rational conversion factors
families.scoring: fraction of conversions within 1e-9 relative tolerance

families.task_shape: compute 5 descriptive statistics for a small numeric sample
families.premise: explicit percentile and ddof conventions
families.scoring: fraction of statistics within 1e-6 relative tolerance

families.task_shape: represent K integers in a requested base
families.premise: positional notation with a small, closed digit alphabet
families.scoring: fraction of representations that parse to the correct integer

families.task_shape: multiply or transpose small integer matrices
families.premise: exact integer arithmetic, fully specified operation
families.scoring: fraction of correct output cells

families.task_shape: shift K dates by days or months with end-of-month clamping
families.premise: ISO-8601 civil calendar, documented clamping rule
families.scoring: fraction of dates that match exactly

families.task_shape: extract a fixed set of typed fields from a short document into JSON
families.premise: closed schema with explicit per-field comparison rules
families.scoring: fraction of schema fields that match (set semantics for tags, order for steps)

families.task_shape: parse 2-3 semi-structured log lines into typed records
families.premise: explicit timestamp/level/code normalisation rules
families.scoring: fraction of record fields that match after normalisation

families.task_shape: write K regular expressions, each labelled with positive/negative examples
families.premise: executable pattern semantics against a labelled string set, including held-out probes
families.scoring: fraction of specifications that classify every labelled string correctly

families.task_shape: render a K-line template with formatting and escaping rules
families.premise: closed placeholder alphabet with explicit filters
families.scoring: fraction of rendered lines that match exactly

families.task_shape: write K SQL queries against a small schema
families.premise: queries are executed on a visible dataset and a held-out probe dataset
families.scoring: fraction of queries whose result set matches on both datasets

families.task_shape: compute count/sum/mean per group from a small table
families.premise: closed aggregation semantics with documented rounding
families.scoring: fraction of group-metric cells that match

families.task_shape: sort K records by up to three keys with stable ties
families.premise: total order specified explicitly; stability is part of the answer
families.scoring: fraction of output positions holding the expected record

families.task_shape: merge overlapping half-open intervals
families.premise: half-open [a,b) semantics; touching endpoints are not merged
families.scoring: fraction of expected merged intervals present at the right position

families.task_shape: find shortest paths for K start/goal pairs on an obstacle grid
families.premise: exact BFS distance; obstacle and adjacency rules are decidable
families.scoring: fraction of paths that are valid, obstacle-free and optimal length

families.task_shape: colour K small graphs under edge and pin constraints
families.premise: finite domains; constraints are decidable and multiple solutions are legal
families.scoring: fraction of sub-problems whose assignment satisfies every constraint

families.task_shape: place K small meeting sets into free calendar slots
families.premise: 30-minute discrete slots; availability and room conflicts are decidable
families.scoring: fraction of sub-schedules satisfying availability, duration and non-overlap

families.task_shape: produce a topological order for K DAGs
families.premise: any order satisfying all edge constraints is correct
families.scoring: fraction of DAGs whose output order respects every edge and lists each node once

families.task_shape: advance one Conway Life board by one generation (dead border)
families.premise: fully deterministic local rule
families.scoring: fraction of output rows that match exactly

families.task_shape: repair a buggy Python function against a hidden test harness
families.premise: unit tests are executable ground truth; code runs in an isolated subprocess
families.scoring: fraction of unit tests that pass
